data.action: 俯身扫弦，主音吉他狂飙
data.description: 音律联觉音乐会主舞台，激光与干冰烟雾中，主音吉他手陈怀抱赤红电吉他俯身扫弦，赤龙图腾在追光灯下灼灼发亮——「今晚的规矩只有一条——把音量开到最大！」
data.lighting: stage spotlight and laser beams through dry-ice haze
data.promptProse: At the stage edge, she leans over the red electric guitar, one hand sweeping the strings while the other holds the neck. Spotlights and laser beams cut through the dry-ice haze behind her.
data.title: 陈 · 音律联觉舞台
data.animaCaption: One hand sweeps the strings while the other holds the guitar neck.
